MISSING_COMMAND: No command was provided and neither --help nor --version was requested.
UNKNOWN_COMMAND: The first positional argument is not a documented command. No typo guessing is performed.
INVALID_INVOCATION: A known command was invoked with malformed arguments or an incompatible flag combination.
DELIVERY_ENGINE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: The Delivery semantic engine is not available in this bootstrap. Used by read-only validate until authoritative DSF schemas exist.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Reserved for real schema/graph/invariant validation failure once the Delivery engine exists.
COMPATIBILITY_UNSUPPORTED: The CLI cannot safely operate on the target artifact or version. Must be raised before semantic mutation.
